name: windsor-ai-social-media
description:
Social Media by Windsor.ai is a focused workspace for organic social. It connects your Instagram, Facebook Pages, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn Pages, Threads and Google Business Profile accounts, so you can ask questions in plain language: compare reach, engagement, and follower growth across channels; and see which posts performed best. After you confirm each action, it can also publish posts, reply to comments and reviews, and update videos and listings.

Reporting examples:
- Compare reach, engagement and follower growth across Instagram, Facebook Pages, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn Pages and Threads for the same period.
- Rank posts, Reels, Shorts and videos by views, watch time, saves, shares and comments.
- Instagram: followers, reach, views, interactions, profile link taps, and Reels average watch time and skip rate.
- YouTube: views, watch time, subscribers gained and lost, traffic sources and search terms, audience retention, and comments.
- TikTok: video views, likes, comments, shares and follower changes.
- Facebook Pages and LinkedIn Pages: impressions, reactions, comments, shares and follower growth.
- Threads: post views, likes, replies, reposts and quotes.
- Google Business Profile: Search and Maps views, search keywords, call clicks, website clicks, direction requests and reviews.

Publishing and management, each action only after you confirm it:
- Instagram: publish image, video (Reels), carousel and story posts; comment and reply to comments; hide, unhide or delete comments.
- Facebook Pages: publish text, link and photo posts, edit the text of posts published through Windsor.ai, delete posts, and reply to Messenger messages.
- YouTube: reply to and moderate comments, update video titles, descriptions, tags and privacy status, and add or remove playlist videos.
- LinkedIn Pages: publish text, link and image posts.
- Threads: publish text and image posts and replies.
- Google Business Profile: publish, update and delete posts, reply to reviews, add or remove photos, and update business details, categories, services, attributes, address, hours and open status.
- TikTok is read-only.

Common workflows:
- Compare last month's engagement across all connected channels
- Find your best posts and draft a similar one to publish after you approve it
- Reply to new comments on Instagram and YouTube
- Find the search terms behind your YouTube views and update titles and tags
- Reply to a Google review, after you confirm the wording

It can also upload image files from the chat to a Facebook Page or a LinkedIn company page for use in an image post. It connects only these seven social sources, so the tools stay on task; paid ads are covered by other Windsor.ai listings.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to. All product names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners.

defaultPrompt: Use $social-media-create to draft an Instagram post and publish it after I approve it.
Compare engagement across my Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn pages for the last 30 days.
Which of my recent posts performed best by engagement rate?
capabilities: Analyze Instagram organic reach, engagement, follower growth and media performance
Analyze Google Business Profile location performance
Analyze Facebook Pages organic reach, engagement, followers and posts
Analyze YouTube channel and video performance, search terms and audience retention
Analyze TikTok organic account and video performance
Analyze LinkedIn company page follower growth and organic post performance
Analyze Threads post views, likes, replies and reposts
Compare reach, engagement, follower growth and top posts across connected organic social channels
Publish posts on Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages, Threads and Google Business Profile after confirmation
Reply to and moderate comments on Instagram and YouTube, and reply to Google reviews, after confirmation
Update YouTube video details and Google Business Profile listing details after confirmation
Upload images from the chat to Facebook Pages or LinkedIn company pages for use in image posts

positive.description: Discover connected social media sources and capabilities
positive.prompt: Which social media sources are connected, and what can this app do with them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected accounts for the seven sources in scope and, per connector, the available options and any supported action ids, so the user knows what to ask next.

positive.description: Inspect fields for an Instagram report
positive.prompt: For my connected Instagram account, show the valid fields and options for a post performance report.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns usable field ids and connector options for Instagram so a correct get_data call can be built, without guessing identifiers.

positive.description: Compare engagement across connected social accounts
positive.prompt: Compare engagement across my Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn pages for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns reach, engagement, and follower metrics per connected social account for the last 30 days with a concise comparison, stating the date range.

positive.description: Read, rank, and prepare a confirmed write
positive.prompt: Which of my recent Instagram posts performed best, and could you draft a similar post to publish? Show me the numbers and the draft before posting anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the recent posts, names the best-performing post with its numbers, shows the draft of the new post, lists the actions the connector supports, and asks for explicit confirmation before any execute_action call.

positive.prompt: I have not connected Instagram yet. Give me the setup link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Windsor.ai setup URL for connecting or authorizing Instagram, instead of describing manual dashboard steps.

negative.description: Public or competitor data not in the user's connected accounts
negative.prompt: How many Instagram followers does Nike have?
Generate a set of stock photos for my Instagram feed.

negative.description: General advice unrelated to connected accounts
negative.prompt: Explain the history of social media marketing.

review.commerce_description: Windsor.ai does not sell products, show plans, or process payments in the app.

publication.release_notes: Bring the listing in line with the seven sources and the write actions the endpoint serves. Threads is added as the seventh source. The description gains a Reporting examples block of eight lines, a Publishing and management block with one line per source (Instagram posts, stories and comments; Facebook Pages posts, post edits and Messenger replies; YouTube comments, video details and playlists; LinkedIn Pages posts; Threads posts and replies; Google Business Profile posts, reviews, photos and listing details; TikTok read-only) and five workflow lines. Starter prompt 2 and review case 3 add YouTube. Capability labels go from 9 to 12, keywords from 26 to 78. The five skills name the seven sources and the added actions. Title, subtitle and MCP configuration unchanged. No server behavior changes.
